title: finding(tooling): CI "Type Check · workspace" OOMs in plugin-hono-server (tsc exit 134, no type error) because its tsconfig type-checks spec's dist .d.ts without skipLibCheck, and the heap margin on main is nearly gone
body:
Filing class: ① a product defect with a named location and a reproduction. Here the product is the repo's required CI lane.

reach: measured on the public CI entry. The `Type Check · workspace` job of PR #26244 died with a tsc heap OOM (exit 134, no type error) at heads `2d0dd7dd` and `c33b95d8`. The same lane passed at `6c5c49cc` with identical types (run 40370187707 is the red at `c33b95d8`).

**Business reason.** Any PR that touches `packages/spec` pulls `plugin-hono-server` into the affected set. When the lane OOMs it goes red on a PR with no type error, and the seat must re-run the job or stall the merge queue. Each re-run costs a CI cycle, and the chance of a red grows with every spec declaration added. If nothing is done, the lane will fail on `main` itself once the margin is gone.

**Who acts.** The seat that owns tooling and CI, after triage routes it. The fix is one line plus a measurement (below).

## Measurement (by the #25779 dev, recorded in os-dev-report 6424852503)

- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server`'s tsconfig extends nothing and sets no `skipLibCheck`, so tsc type-checks `@objectstack/spec`'s dist `.d.ts`.
- Measured under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4136`, the CI limit:

  | Tree | Peak RSS | Passes at 4136 MB | Passes at 3900 MB | Check time |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
  | `main` | 4,745,939 KB | yes | not measured | not measured |
  | the #25779 branch | 4,770,597 KB | yes | no | 67.6 s |
  | with `skipLibCheck: true` | 872,405 KB | yes | not measured | 3.85 s, 0 errors |

- #25657 measured `main` at 4,167,189 KB on 2026-10-24, so the margin is shared with `main` and is shrinking.

## Expected

The lane passes with a real margin. The likely fix is `skipLibCheck: true` in that tsconfig, or extending the repo's base tsconfig that already sets it, so long as no lib-check-only error class is lost. Confirm that by reading what the other plugins' tsconfigs do.

## Dedupe

The query "typecheck heap out of memory plugin-hono-server tsc OOM skipLibCheck" in objectstack issues returned 6 hits, all closed: #17708, #14569 (same class, other lanes: the type-check-debt and debt-ledger tsc OOMs), #18435, #12711, #10451, #10444. None covers `plugin-hono-server` or the workspace lane.
